remarks:
Welcome to St. Mary's Square condos!  The renovated historic building is filled with charm and beautiful architectural details  along with all the modern conveniences you would want.

Unit 1C is spacious and flooded with natural light.  An open entry area, lots of closet space and tasteful updates combine architectural beauty and all the modern conveniences you could wish for.  The living room features hardwood floors and expansive windows that give a light and airy feel to the living space.

The completely remodeled kitchen, including appliances (2022) features plentiful cupboards, quartz counters and a pass through to the dining area that overlooks the living room.

A generous office area provides a great 'work from home' space.  The large bedroom with expansive closet
is a quiet retreat.  A remodeled bathroom (2021) only steps from the bedroom features a step in shower.

Pay as you go laundry in the carefully maintained basement, provides a pleasant place for this chore.

A locked storage unit, and additional locked bicycle storage unit make this the most useful basement.

Owner may rent unit with board approval and 1 year lease. Dogs up to 25lbs allowed.
